title: DREO Space Heater, Portable Electric Heaters for Indoor Use with Thermostat, 2026 Upgraded, 34dB Quiet, 12H Timer, Remote, 1500W PTC Ceramic, Gold
features: Powerful heat that fits everywhere: Dreo combines a Hyperamics 1500W PTC system with a heat funnel design to deliver heat within seconds and enhance warm air circulation for up to 200% farther reach than traditional heaters.
Unbreakable safety: tilt-detection sensor for tip-over protection, V0 flame-retardant materials, overheat protection, and a safety plug, all certified by ETL.
Ultimate temperature control: enhanced NTC chipset lets you set heat from 41-95°F in 1°F increments.
Cozy quietness: brushless DC motor and winglet fan design, listed at 34 dB.
Fits into your lifestyle: carry handle, Power heat, ECO, and Fan Only modes, plus remote control, 12-hour timer, mute, child lock, and memory function.

Product information for this Gold model (DR-HSH006): tower form, indoor only, corded electric, 120V, 12.5A, 1500W PTC ceramic, heating coverage listed at 200 sq ft, 12-month warranty extendable up to 30 months by registering the product.
